title: MOFA expresses deepest condolences on passing of former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda
text:
Minister of Foreign Affairs Lin Chia-lung expresses sincere condolences on the passing of former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda, who died in Tokyo on October 22. Minister Lin has instructed the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office (TECRO) in Japan to convey the heartfelt sympathies of the people and government of Taiwan to the family of former Prime Minister Fukuda.

Former Prime Minister Fukuda long maintained strong ties with Taiwan. He visited Taiwan and personally called at TECRO in Japan to offer his condolences on the passing of former President Lee Teng-hui.

Taiwan and Japan are important partners and close friends that share the fundamental values of democracy, freedom, human rights, and the rule of law. Building on these existing foundations, MOFA looks forward to both sides continuing to deepen exchanges and cooperation in all fields, forging even closer and more abiding bonds between the two countries. (E)
